name: KLUBB: Espen Iden + Juicy Charles + Globaldrama
description:
Hometown hero ESPEN IDEN is back in town together with Charlie (JUICY CHARLES) and Dahir (GLOBALDRAMA) To celebrate we take over revolver basement for a night to remember!
__________________________________________
Espen Iden (Pyramiden) is an interdisciplinary artist from Bergen, Norway, and has been an eclectic DJ since 2012. Known for his high energy genre-fluid sets, he has played most major club and rave concepts in Norway. His biggest musical influence comes from gangster rap and proto-house, which is apparent in his sets, mixing techno, trance, ghettotech, breakbeats, hardcore, jungle, electro, and staby tunes in a big mashup.
https://on.soundcloud.com/PwMNC
https://on.soundcloud.com/d7YSW
https://open.spotify.com/artist/7cDg1YEWjhiDveH3NICg5z...
__________________________________________
Juicy Charles (Vibbefanger, Fucket Freakkvens) started his DJ career in Shanghai in 2014. Since then he has made his own podcasts, participated in making club events in China, Japan, Vietnam, London and Norway, and co-founded the music collective Fucket Freakkvens based in Oslo which has hosted several raves and events in Norway with local and international talent.
His music style is playful and bouncy eclectic club music.
https://soundcloud.com/juicycharles
__________________________________________
GLOBALDRAMA is a by name and sonic handle for artist Dahir H. GB’s sound straddles the line between exploratory ritualistic club culture and poetics of detailed sound design. Cross genre and queer encounters between techno, house, funk and various deconstructed sound that’s rooted in uptempo African rhythms recklessly combined with some DIY elements to reveal a new and confrontational personality, setting free both body and speech
